raw.description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

The Job

  • Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

  • Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

  • Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

  • Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

  • Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

  • Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

  • Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

  • Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

  • Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

  • Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

  • A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

  • Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

  • Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

  • Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

  • Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

  • An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

raw.description:
About the Company

Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development.

In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment.

Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most.

Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment.

Position Overview

Ajaia is hiring a Cloud Security & DevOps Engineer to manage and secure the company's multi-cloud infrastructure across GCP and Azure. This is a technical, hands-on role. You will configure infrastructure, enforce security controls, manage deployment pipelines, and build automation that reduces manual overhead across IT and security operations.

The company operates AI products across regulated industries, so you will support compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC 2) at the infrastructure level. You are expected to think about security as part of every system you build or maintain, not as an afterthought. Internal IT operations (access management, endpoint security, onboarding automation) are also part of your scope.

The company is AI-first. You should already be using AI tools to write scripts, analyze logs, generate documentation, and accelerate your engineering work.

We expect candidates to use AI in daily workflows across research, ideation, drafting, design iteration, quality checks, and delivery acceleration. AI fluency is a core execution requirement, not optional tooling.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 2–5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Cloud engineering and infrastructure management (GCP, Azure, or multi-cloud)
    • DevOps, site reliability engineering, or platform engineering
    • Infrastructure security and cloud security implementation
    • CI/CD pipeline management and deployment automation
  • Hands-on experience managing cloud environments across GCP and Azure (multi-cloud experience required)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar)
  • Experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: IAM policies, network segmentation, firewall rules, encryption at rest and in transit
  • Scripting ability in Python, Bash, or similar languages
  • Experience configuring and managing security monitoring and alerting systems
  • Ability to support internal IT operations: access management (SSO, MFA, RBAC), endpoint security, and onboarding automation
  • Familiarity with compliance requirements at the infrastructure level (HIPAA, SOC 2 preferred)
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to maintain clear infrastructure and security records
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, fully remote, distributed environment
  • Proficiency with AI tools in daily technical work

Preferred Requirements:

  • Relevant certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Azure Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
  • Experience with container orchestration and container security (Kubernetes, Cloud Run, Docker, or similar)
  • Experience with service mesh, network policies, or micro-segmentation
  • Background supporting regulated workloads in healthcare or financial services
  • Experience with SIEM platforms, vulnerability scanning tools, or penetration testing coordination
  • Experience with system performance monitoring, availability engineering, and cost optimization
  • Familiarity with compliance evidence collection and audit support at the infrastructure level
  • Background with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or similar)

Benefits

  • Base salary: Approximately $28,000–$35,000 USD per year (calibrated for target regions).
  • Performance bonus: Opportunity to earn up to 100% of base salary in performance-based bonuses.
  • Salary and total compensation depend on experience, location, and demonstrated performance during the hiring process.

raw.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

raw.description:
Technical Delivery Analyst

Remote (UK-based)

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're hiring the first dedicated Technical Delivery Analyst. You will own the delivery of software projects end-to-end — from requirements through to production — working alongside engineers to ensure work lands on time, risks are visible, and stakeholders always know where things stand. As our engineering organisation grows into more specialised teams, you are the person who sits across the space between them — owning the dependencies, coordination, and communication that no single team owns.

This is not an administrative role. You need to understand the technology being built, speak credibly with engineers about architecture and trade-offs, and translate technical reality into clear communication for the business. You are the person who knows what is happening, why it matters, and what might go wrong — and you make sure everyone else knows too.

You will work closely with the Head of Technical Delivery and daily with Engineering, TechOps, and Product, with regular interaction with client-facing teams (Sales, Client Services). The role offers a clear path to Delivery Manager as the team grows and you take on broader ownership.

What You'll Work On

Delivery Ownership:

  • Own projects from inception to production — responsible for outcomes, not just process

  • Understand technical scope, architecture, and dependencies well enough to anticipate problems before they surface

  • Ensure infrastructure, testing, performance, and operational readiness are considered from the start

  • Know the current state of your projects at all times

Communication:

  • Communicate early and often — bad news delivered early is manageable; bad news delivered late is a crisis

  • Provide honest, accurate status updates — never spin, never hide, never assume someone else will raise it

  • Tailor to the audience — technical detail for engineers, business impact for leadership, actionable clarity for everyone

Technical Engagement:

  • Participate meaningfully in technical discussions — you don't write code, but you understand what is being built and why

  • Engage with engineers on architecture, dependencies, and integration points to accurately assess delivery risk

  • Bridge engineering and business by translating technical constraints into language stakeholders can act on

Risk Management:

  • Identify risks early through genuine understanding of the work, not by reading ticket statuses

  • Escalate with context — what is the risk, what is the impact, what are the options

  • Contribute to post-incident reviews with a delivery lens — impact, learnings, prevention

Continuous Improvement:

  • Look for friction in how work flows and propose practical improvements

  • Experiment with AI tooling to improve delivery efficiency — reporting, analysis, coordination, and communication

  • Maintain delivery tooling as a means to an end, not an end in itself

What We Need

Technical:

  • 2+ years' experience in technical delivery, project management, or software engineering

  • Previously worked as a software developer, or strong hands-on technical experience with software systems

  • Comfortable reading code, reviewing pull requests for context, and understanding technical trade-offs without simplification

  • Knows what "done" looks like in production — tested, deployed, monitored, documented

  • Familiarity with Agile practices and tools (Jira, Confluence) — values principles over ceremony

  • Financial services or trading technology experience is a strong advantage

How you work:

  • You own it. End-to-end responsibility. If it's your project, it's your problem — you don't wait for someone to tell you something is off

  • You communicate clearly. Exceptional written and verbal communication. Concise, precise, and honest under pressure. Confident raising difficult topics early — with engineers, stakeholders, and leadership alike — and you absorb pushback as readily as you give it, redirecting heat toward the outcome rather than taking it personally

  • You build trust. Engineers respect people who understand the work, tell the truth, and follow through — not a title. You are genuinely interested in the people you work with, and over time they bring you problems before those problems reach a ticket

  • You steady the room. When a project is drifting or an incident is live, you lower the temperature rather than raise it — calm, calibrated, and focused on what needs to happen next

  • You think in outcomes. Updating a board is not the same as delivering software. You impose structure where needed without over-engineering process

  • You stay technically curious. You genuinely want to understand how systems work and fit together. You don't simplify away the complexity that matters

  • You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You exercise judgement. You know when to escalate, when to solve, and when to ask for help

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools to amplify our delivery capability — from reporting and analysis to coordination and communication. You should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real delivery problems — owning end-to-end project outcomes on a market-leading trading platform with genuine scale and technical depth

  • Breadth of exposure — work across the full engineering organisation: backend, frontend, platform, infrastructure, and TechOps

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Direct mentorship — access to the Head of Technical Delivery for coaching, feedback, and professional development

  • Career progression — a clear path to Delivery Manager as the team grows and you take on broader ownership

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Senior Leadership Conversation with our CTO

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy [link to be added].

About Us:
At edclub, we are committed to revolutionizing the way K-12 students learn through engaging and interactive educational content. We create comprehensive, high-quality courses that inspire curiosity and facilitate deep learning. We're seeking a talented Designer to join our dynamic team to help bring educational content to life with creativity and purpose.

Job Description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to join our team. In this role, you will design educational materials that enhance learning experiences for students. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of user experience principles and a passion for creating intuitive, visually appealing digital products. You will collaborate with project managers, developers, and content creators to produce visually engaging and interactive educational tools

This role will be fully remote, as our headquarters are located in Rockville, Maryland, USA.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create graphics, illustrations, and visual elements for experiences that align with educational objectives.
  • Work closely with curriculum and content teams to ensure design elements support educational goals.
  • Ensure a consistent visual style that is age-appropriate and accessible to diverse audiences.
  • Collaborate with the team to brainstorm creative ideas and solutions for presenting content in innovative ways.
  • Create engaging animations and motion graphics to enhance student learning and understanding.
  • Stay up-to-date with design trends, animation techniques, and educational tools to continuously improve content quality.

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of proven experience in graphic and UI/UX design.
  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Illustrator; experience with animation tools like After Effects, Blender, or similar.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design and animation work.
  • Understanding of visual storytelling, typography, and layout principles.
  • Knowledge of user-centered design principles and how students of different age groups engage with content.
  • Communicate effectively in English with team members.
  • Collaborative attitude with a willingness to accept feedback and adapt designs accordingly.
  • Ability to think creatively and bring innovative ideas to enhance student engagement.

The Mission

Generic stock vectors and uninspired corporate graphics are completely dead to us. We need a precision visual designer to forge the premium aesthetic identity of the Partyhat universe. Your job is to take abstract product concepts and turn them into visceral, high-impact digital illustrations, hero graphics, and custom visual assets that give our digital web ecosystem a sharp, undeniable edge. This is a remote, asset-focused role for a digital artist who knows how to blend clean modern web layout principles with the fast-paced, high-stakes vibe of the internet-native economy.

We don't care about a formal art degree or a resume filled with corporate agencies, we care about the raw power, execution, and utility of your digital portfolio. If you have the drive to master our core brand identity, the speed to match our high-velocity shipping cadence, and the structural discipline to deliver web-ready files that integrate flawlessly with modern interfaces, we will give you the ultimate digital canvas to build your legacy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Brand World-Building: Conceive, sketch, and render high-fidelity characters, environments, and custom typography that anchor our brand’s digital presence.

  • Web Asset Production: Ship sharp, high-octane graphic illustrations, landing page hero graphics, UI icon sets, and social media art assets at high velocity.

  • Vector Execution: Translate complex visual illustrations into clean, perfectly scalable vector formats and layered design assets ready for immediate web implementation.

  • Aesthetic Mastery: Seamlessly implement and expand our signature design language, maintaining flawless scaling, balance, and color harmony across all digital touchpoints.

  • Rapid Prototyping: Collaborate daily with our Product and Design teams, taking abstract concepts, wireframes, and mood boards and breathing immediate visual life into them.

  • Asset Governance: Maintain a flawless, perfectly cataloged library of all master files, ensuring our global engineering and marketing teams can deploy your work instantly.

The Requirements

  • The "Visual Craft": A breathtaking digital art portfolio displaying master-level composition, vector execution, clean line work, and a distinct digital-native point of view.

  • Technical Agility: Advanced proficiency with industry-standard digital tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent vector/raster software software).

  • Web-Ready Logic: A deep understanding of designing for digital layouts, resolution optimization, file sizing, and how illustration scales across responsive web environments.

  • Hyper-Availability: This isn't a slow studio setup. When major launches hit or product features pivot, you must be responsive and ready to iterate on specific creative tweaks in real time.

  • Operational Excellence: Self-motivated and highly organized; you can crush tight project deadlines and manage hundreds of working layers and file versions without losing a single detail.

Operational Details

  • Location: Fully Remote.

  • Schedule: Flexible / On-call (Requires high responsiveness for rapid asset delivery).

  • Compensation:Hourly Rate or Retainer (Based entirely on portfolio elite-level).

  • Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT).

Why Join Us?

We offer more than just an art commission; we offer the chance to paint the visual blueprint of a global powerhouse.

  • Absolute Creative Sovereignty: We value raw aesthetic output over bureaucratic red tape. If your visual direction is sharp and moves the needle, we run it.

  • Global Canvas: Your custom illustrations will instantly step onto a global stage, defining the experience for thousands of active web users every single day.

  • A Culture of Momentum: Join a team that moves at lightspeed. You will be constantly creating, testing new visual boundaries, and seeing your art deployed to production in real time.

  • High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For a Digital Illustrator whose visual style defines our product culture, there is a clear runway for long-term partnership and increased structural leverage.

This role is ideal for a results-driven B2B sales manager with deep experience in the study abroad industry.

Our mission is bold but simple: by 2030, we aim to dismantle the barriers preventing brilliant minds from accessing the opportunities they deserve. Starting with financial barriers, we provide loans to international students and refugees so they can pursue higher education in Canada and unlock a world of possibilities.

Who You Are

  • Results-Oriented: You thrive on clear targets and deliver measurable outcomes

  • Growth-Focused: You are obsessed about driving scale quickly and efficiently

  • Monitor partner activation through CRM analytics and identify growth opportunities

What You Bring

Skills

Mission: At Clever Digital Marketing, we are on a mission to empower large-scale home improvement companies by fueling their top-line revenue through innovative digital marketing strategies. By bridging the gap in the industry for a highly profitable digital lead vendor, we’ve created a unique space where growth isn’t just supported—it’s catalyzed.
Product: Clever Digital Marketing delivers outcome-driven paid advertising and strategic advising solutions. We don’t focus on clicks and impressions—we focus on net sales. Our customized, data-driven strategies are tailored to each client’s unique needs, ensuring measurable impact and scalable profitability.
Scale: In just three years, we’ve partnered with over 50 large-scale home improvement companies across the USA and Canada, helping them generate $250 million in revenue. By integrating seamlessly with our partners and leveraging our core value of Extreme Ownership, we’ve set bold targets, driving shared success. We’re on track to help our clients achieve $325 million in revenue next year.
Impact: As trusted subject matter experts in the home improvement space, we are redefining what it means to deliver value. Our commitment to authenticity and collaboration ensures we remain a powerhouse of growth, innovation, and measurable results for every client we serve.

Who We're Looking For
CDM is seeking a dedicated Senior Performance Marketing Specialist with Facebook advertising experience and a relentless focus on hitting performance targets. The ideal candidate must possess a strong desire to learn and solve problems, lead account strategy and scale accounts.
As a Senior Performance Marketing Specialist, you take the lead and full ownership of the marketing success on accounts, while our Client Services team takes ownership of the client relationship, assisting you with hitting your targets.

What You'll Do

  • Launch and manage multiple client campaigns on Facebook, Instagram and other paid social platforms for high-tier clients, ensuring that all campaigns meet or exceed their KPIs
  • Manage high-value client accounts, ensuring all campaign objectives are met or exceeded
  • Develop and implement tailored strategies to meet client objectives, leveraging in-depth platform knowledge
  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, making data-driven optimizations to improve results
  • Provide guidance and support to junior team members, helping them to develop their skills and improve campaign outcomes
  • Proactively identify and pursue opportunities to scale successful campaigns and optimize underperforming ones
  • Use data-driven insights to make informed decisions on budget allocation and targeting strategies
  • Create and implement robust A/B testing frameworks to continuously optimize campaign performance
  • Craft high-converting copy to support ad campaigns, landing page conversion rates & video campaign performance
  • Manage a Meta/TikTok ad budget ranging between $200,000 and $400,000 per month of performance spend
  • Scripting for ad copy, creatives, and different messaging in your advertorials
  • Collaborate with our Creative team to improve video ad campaigns
  • Collaborate with the CSM team to identify and resolve high-level issues
What You Will Not Do:
  • Client Communication
  • 30-day client approvals
  • Siloed or extremely collaborative work – at CDM, we believe in a fine balance between the two

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 3 years of experience managing performance Facebook campaigns for lead generation
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in an agency setting
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in direct response marketing
  • Experience managing 100K+/mo in performance spend focused on lead generation
  • Experience with creative briefs & ideating video campaigns
  • Advanced knowledge and practical experience with Facebook and Instagram ad platforms
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Highly preferred: Experience in enhancing conversion rate optimization

What We Offer

  • An incredible team and culture. We’re a high-performance, feedback-oriented, and data-driven organization where everyone is empowered to succeed. Our culture thrives on collaboration, extreme ownership, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We believe in integrity as a cornerstone of our success, making decisions that align with our principles even when it’s challenging. We celebrate winning together by supporting and lifting each other up, ensuring every victory is shared. At our core, we embrace Kaizen, the philosophy of continuous improvement, knowing that small changes can lead to extraordinary results. This is more than a workplace—it’s a place where you’ll grow, learn, and thrive alongside passionate teammates who are as invested in your success as you are.
  • Be part of a rapidly scaling company that’s redefining performance marketing for the home improvement industry.
  • Competitive compensation that reflects your expertise and contributions.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment, with the option to collaborate in person at our beautiful Vaughan office whenever you need a change of pace.
  • 15 days of paid time off (PTO) annually, with the freedom to use them as you see fit.
  • Comprehensive group benefits, including health, dental, and more, to support your well-being.
  • A company-provided MacBook and a home office budget to help you create your ideal workspace.
  • Merch deliveries to help you get started and feel part of the team.
  • A work abroad policy to support you when you need a fresh perspective or a new working environment.
  • Opportunities to connect with #Clever teammates in person, whether at our Vaughan office, through meetups across Canada, or at company-wide events and off-sites.

Clever Digital Marketing values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of support during the recruitment and selection process. About Us

Mangone Law Firm, LLC is a New Jersey-based immigration law firm that has been dedicated since 2012 to helping new Americans obtain legal status in the U.S. We proudly represent immigrants nationwide and are fully committed to excellence in customer service — deeply understanding our clients' challenges and genuinely caring about their outcomes. raw.title: Senior Nursing Executive
raw.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Nursing Executive to join our Solution Design organization. As a strategic partner within the commercial team, you will provide expert clinical insights, support the evaluation of Abridge’s nursing solutions, and act as the clinical voice and advocate during customer interactions. Leveraging your clinical background and technological expertise, you will bridge the gap between clinical practice and technology implementation, ensuring our solutions effectively address real-world nursing challenges. This role will help articulate and translate the value of Abridge’s nursing solutions clearly and effectively to senior clinical and executive leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Clinical Expertise and Advocacy: Serve as a clinical resource supporting sales and partner success teams by demonstrating how Abridge’s nursing solutions enhance clinical workflows and patient outcomes.

  • Strategic Commercial Support: Partner closely with commercial teams during demos, customer presentations, and strategic engagements, providing clinical credibility and subject matter expertise to executive-level audiences.

  • Customer Engagement: Act as the "boots on the ground" voice of nursing, engaging directly with prospective and current customers, including senior leadership, to articulate clinical value, address questions, and facilitate adoption.

  • Solution Feedback Loop: Regularly provide insights and feedback from prospect interactions to the product and engineering teams, assisting in prioritizing product enhancements to align with clinical needs.

  • Thought Leadership: Represent Abridge at industry conferences, webinars, and events as a clinical thought leader, enhancing Abridge’s credibility within the healthcare community.

  • Product Expertise and Collaboration: Serve as the product expert for the commercial team, collaborating closely with the Product team to ensure alignment between customer needs, solution capabilities, and product roadmap.

What You’ll Bring

  • Clinical Experience: Significant experience as a Registered Nurse, ideally within acute care, critical care, or med-surg background.

  • Technology Integration: Proven track record working in healthcare technology roles (e.g., Clinical Informatics, Enterprise Analytics, Implementation Executive), demonstrating successful adoption and integration of clinical solutions.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to clearly communicate complex clinical and technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including frontline clinicians, healthcare executives, and technical teams.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated experience and comfort engaging and influencing senior executives, including CNOs, CNIOs, CMIOs, CIOs, and CFOs.

  • Collaboration and Leadership: Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally, influence without direct authority, and serve as a trusted clinical advisor internally and externally.

  • Analytical and Strategic Thinking: Ability to evaluate clinical workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate clinical requirements into technological solutions.

Bonus Points If...

  • MSN or equivalent advanced nursing degree preferred.

  • Experience in clinical success, implementation leadership, clinical analytics, or similar roles within major health systems or healthcare technology companies (e.g., Epic).

  • Proven ability to manage and lead teams or complex projects, ideally with experience in healthcare quality, analytics, and informatics initiatives.

***This role requires 30-50% travel***

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $143,650 - $194,040

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

Abridge is embedded in 250+ health systems and expanding rapidly across the federal healthcare ecosystem. The Federal program is one of the most consequential and complex programs in the company, spanning clinical deployment, enterprise IT, government contracting, product integration, and policy. This role owns the success of the program at large.

The Program Director is the operational center of gravity for the federal program. You are responsible for the overall health and forward momentum of key federal partnerships — and for ensuring that every team touching the program is rowing in the same direction. At the heart of this role is a genuine commitment to the mission: improving the lives of clinicians and the patients they serve. That mission is not a backdrop; it is the lens through which strategy is set, trade-offs are made, and progress is measured.

You hold the picture across commercial, product, clinical, engineering, legal, and government affairs, and are accountable for driving alignment, surfacing risk, and ensuring the right people are working on the right things at the right time. You translate strategy into execution, create clarity where there is ambiguity, and serve as the connective tissue that keeps a complex, multi-stakeholder program moving with purpose.

This is a role for someone who has run complex programs before and knows the difference between keeping a tracker current and actually moving a program. You will have a lot of surface area to cover and not a lot of hand-holding. You will need to evolve operating rhythms as the program matures, earn trust with senior internal and external stakeholders, and be the person who knows where everything stands.

This role reports to the Head of Partner Success.

What You’ll Do
Mission-driven leadership and cross-functional alignment
Ensure that every internal team contributing to the federal program — product, clinical, commercial, engineering, legal, and government affairs — understands the strategy, is aligned on goals, and is working in a unified direction. Ground cross-functional priorities in the mission to serve clinicians and patients, and hold that mission as the north star when navigating trade-offs, resolving friction, or making day-to-day decisions. Create the clarity teams need to execute with confidence, and proactively resolve misalignment before it becomes drag.

Program operations and rhythm
Design and run the operating cadence for the federal program, including weekly cross-functional syncs, dependency tracking, quarterly planning cycles, and exec-level reporting. Maintain the single source of truth on strategy, delivery status, outcomes, and goals — ensuring the full team has a shared understanding of what we are working toward, where we stand, and what needs to change. Translate program status into clear, action-oriented communication for internal leadership and federal stakeholders.

Accountability and outcomes
Drive progress against cross-functional goals by establishing clear ownership, tracking delivery against program milestones, and holding internal teams accountable. Lead escalation when things are off track and quarterback cross-functional problem-solving on issues that don't fit neatly into one team's lane. When friction arises — internally or with external partners — provide clear direction and make the calls that keep the program moving.

ELT reporting and escalation
Serve as the primary voice of the federal program to executive leadership. Report out regularly on program health, strategic progress, risks, and outcomes. Escalate decisions, blockers, or resource needs with the context and recommendations needed for swift resolution. Ensure leadership has what they need to act, and that the program has what it needs to succeed.

Federal stakeholder management
Build and maintain strong working relationships with key federal stakeholders across program offices and clinical leadership. Translate customer needs into internal priorities and ensure Abridge is delivering on its commitments. Be a trusted partner to clinicians and program leaders — someone who understands their environment, advocates for their needs, and brings a solutions orientation to every interaction. Partner with the federal commercial team on account strategy and renewal. Lead Abridge relationships with teaming partners to ensure effective service delivery that meets Abridge standards, whether outsourced or internal.

Cross-functional coordination
Serve as the connective tissue across product, commercial, sales, clinical success, legal, and government affairs. Identify where workstreams are misaligned or under-resourced and drive resolution. Own the swim lanes. Know the dependencies. Flag the gaps before they become problems. Ensure that innovation efforts — particularly those aimed at solving complex federal healthcare challenges — are supported, unblocked, and connected to the right internal teams.

Operational infrastructure
Build program management tooling, templates, BI dashboards, and playbooks that scale as the federal footprint grows. raw.description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities.

The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation.

You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization.

We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale.

Role description

Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing

Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines.

Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation.

Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities.

Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk).

Background and Experience

Quantitative Risk Expertise: Strong foundation in quantitative risk management, including hands-on experience with market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk modelling, ideally aligned with frameworks such as those presented in Quantitative Risk Management (McNeil, Frey, Embrechts).

Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes.

System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure.

TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure.

Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments.

Competences and personality

  • Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution

  • The candidate reports to the COO but this is not a reporting role, but a quantitative risk management system-building role.

Our recruitment philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary and global benefit package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to semi-flexible working hours=

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

Keyrock offers you both a career and a large range of benefits that we will gladly discuss in the course of the application process.

As an employer we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

Location: Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only - supporting a team in the EST time zone.

About the role

We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.

You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or .

This is a copy-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

  • 3–5+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.

  • You write excellent short-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.

  • You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected-device brand is a strong plus.

  • You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt-in copy, welcome series, first-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.

  • You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role.

  • You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.

  • You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.

  • You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.

  • You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.

  • You are detail-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.

  • You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.

  • Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, , or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

A day in the life

  • Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.

  • Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.

  • Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.

  • Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.

  • Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.

  • Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.

  • Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.

  • Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Ce vei face in calitate de Content Writer in echipa DWF?

Așadar, fără să ne mai lungim, iată atribuțiile principale ale unui Content Writer la Digital Workforce:

  • Comunici cu membrii celorlalte departamente
  • Comunici cu clienții și managerii care le gestionează conturile pentru a te alinia cu cerințele și așteptările acestora.
  • Te familiarizezi cu nișa clientului
  • Identifici publicul țintă al articolului pe care urmează să-l scrii, intenția și așteptările cititorilor. Totodată, cauți și cele mai bune surse de informații.
  • Redactezi cel mai bun articol pe tema identificată de Content Arhitecții noștri ținând cont de:

- Limbajul potrivit pentru nișa dată. Tonul fiecărui articol este dat atât de cerințele clientului, cât și de platforma pe care urmează a fi publicate.
- Brandul clientului (știm că acest pas poate suna înfricoșător, dar noi avem deja rețeta completă pentru un brand content puternic).
- Experiența utilizatorului (UE) care cere o structură ușor de parcurs și lipsa absolută a oricăror greșeli de redactare.
- Feedbackul colegilor și al clientului care ne ajută să devenim mai buni cu fiecare articol redactat.

Cum devii Content Writer in echipa DWF?

  • Absolvent studii superioare in Litere, Filologie, Limbi și Literaturi Străine
  • Experiență de minim 2 ani pe o poziție similară de Copywriter Publicitate
  • Experiență în redactare articole din diferite domenii
  • Cunoștințe medii Wordpress, abilitati editare online
  • (Opțional) Cunoașterea fundamentelor SEO și a principiilor de marketing digital.

Iată cateva din motivele pentru care trebuie sa te alaturi DWF:

  4. Work from Home (până când ne vom putea întâlni în siguranță la birou, toată activitatea se desfășoară în regim de telemuncă).
  5. DWF Talks (sesiuni periodice de discuții libere în cadrul echipei, sau cu un invitat extern, din alt domeniu sau altă agenție de marketing).
  6. Acces la evenimente (DWF este partener în toate evenimentele relevante de E-commerce din România).
  7. DWF Party (știm să ne bucurăm de reușite, motiv pentru care organizăm, în medie, patru petreceri pe an, dintre care cel puțin una este… în afara orașului).
  8. DWF Exchange (programul DWF de schimb de experiență, cu agenții SEO - și nu numai - din Europa).
  9. Abonament la Bookster
  10. Oportunitatea de a lucra la cea mai mare agenție SEO din România (cu peste 650 de campanii SEO derulate de-a lungul a 7 ani în care ne-am menținut pe pozițiile de top pe piața din România, poți avea încredere că DWF nu oferă doar un loc de muncă, ci o experiență în perfecționarea abilităților tale de redactare a unui articol SEO demn de prima poziție în Google).

raw.description:
Noë & Associates is a global brand consultancy working across real estate, hospitality, and luxury. We specialise in the unbuilt — creating brands and telling the stories of places before they exist. From our studios in New York, London, and Dubai, we have helped bring billions of dollars of developments to market for clients including Aman, Rosewood, Mandarin Oriental, Jumeirah, and IHG.
We are hiring an AI Cinematographer to help us picture the unbuilt: cinematic film and motion, made with the new generation of generative video tools, for some of the world’s most ambitious luxury developments and destinations.
We are proud to be part of Together Group, a curated collective of high-quality creative consultancies, marketing, technology and production studios. Together, we create and elevate brands, experiences and destinations of the future.

This role is initially offered on a contract basis, with the potential to become permanent.

Key Responsibilities

The role

This is a craft role at the frontier. You trained in film and you think like a cinematographer — in composition, lens, light, movement, and pace — and you have carried that language into AI video, where the tools now let us show a place, a feeling, and a way of living long before anything is built.
You will work alongside our strategists, designers, editors, and producers to develop the look and feel of residences, resorts, and destinations still in design — turning a vision into something a client and their audience can actually see and feel.

What you’ll do

• Create cinematic film and motion with generative video tools — from early concept films to finished campaign work.
• Work primarily in Kling, our current tool of choice, with room to use Seedance and other tools where they serve the work better.
• Translate real cinematographic craft — framing, lensing, lighting, camera movement, edit rhythm — into prompts, references, and generative workflows that hold a high bar for taste and finish.
• Develop looks and visual worlds for the unbuilt: places that do not yet exist, made convincing and beautiful on screen.
• Exercise judgement about tools — which model or approach serves a given shot, and when a result is genuinely good enough to ship.
• Stay at the edge of a fast-moving field and bring back what is worth using.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• A real grounding in film. Film school or equivalent training, with genuine command of cinematic language, pacing, and storytelling — film specifically, not photography. You think in motion, and you know how a single shot lives within a sequence.

raw.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Spanish-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Spanish Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $15 - $18 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.
    • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.

Schedule: Full time and Part time schedules available


We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Spanish Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Spanish and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver audio and video interpretation services and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during the interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inSpanish and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Fourteen (14) days from the posting date of September 20, 2026.
